newsitem.title: POLAND: Kredyt Bank buys PBI, Prosper banks.
newsitem.headline: Kredyt Bank buys PBI, Prosper banks.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland, the central bank, agreed to sell Polish Investment Bank (PBI) and Prosper Bank in a joint deal to Kredyt Bank for 205 million zlotys and investment guarantees, the NBP deputy head said.
"We have just signed an agreement on the sale of two NBP-owned banks," Witold Kozinski told a news conference.
"This transaction of joining Kredyt Bank and PBI bank consolidates the Polish banking system and helps to save once and for all the fate of Prosper Bank," Kozinski added.
Kozinski said Kredyt Bank would take over 100 percent of PBI and 92.36 percent of Prosper Bank.
Kredyt Bank vowed to invest in Prosper 160 million zlotys which is roughly equivalent to its debts and increase the bank's capital to five million Ecu within several years.
It also will raise the share capital of PBI by 100 million zlotys within a year and pledged to invest another 25 million zlotys in PBI's computer infrastructure.
The deal also envisions the possibility of PBI employees buying some of the bank's shares, Kozinski said.
Kredyt Bank president Stanislaw Pacuk, also present, said the bank would use some of its own capital to pay for the banks but gave no further details on the deal's financing.
"The merger will make Kredyt Bank and PBI Poland's eighth largest bank in terms of assets," Pacuk said.
Kozinski said Kredyt outbid Austria's Creditanstalt, the other shortlisted bidder, and U.S. GE Capital, which did not make the final cut-off.
At the end of 1996 PBI had capital of 197.1 million zlotys, a balance sheet total of 4.56 billion zlotys and recorded a 55.2 million zloty net profit that year.
Prosper Bank, 93-percent owned by the central bank, has capital of 16.1 million zlotys and an accumulated loss of 161 million zlotys. It has a balance sheet total of 557 million zlotys.
Under the conditions of the tender investors who wanted to buy PBI were also required to buy Prosper Bank.
At the end of 1996 Kredyt Bank had capital of 219 million zlotys, making a net profit that year of 23.2 million zlotys. Its balance sheet total was 1.07 billion zlotys.
